name: Stuart Bailey
bio:
After a long career in sales and management with department stores like Dillard’s and Macy’s, I followed my lifelong interest in real estate and joined my good friend Pat Wattam in the business. My stores did well because customers left feeling good about the experience, and I bring that same approach to every buyer and seller I work with.

I’m a native of Dallas and spent my school years in Minneapolis before returning to Texas for college, earning a Bachelor of Science in Economics from Southern Methodist University. The last 15 years have been in Louisiana with my wife and our grown children. I enjoy time with family, working in the yard, and walking the trails around the Baton Rouge area.
